name: The Branching Maze
tagline: Navigate junctions, dead ends, and open corridors using a systematic wall-following strategy.
narrative:
You face an 11x11 maze filled with open junctions, misleading dead ends, and winding corridors.

The robot only senses relative local facts at each tick: wallAhead, wallLeft, wallRight, and atGoal.

Your challenge is to solve the maze using a wall-following strategy. By handling specific junction and dead-end situations before general movement fallbacks, your robot can systematically escape any maze layout!
objective: Navigate the 11×11 Branching Maze, reach the exit, and settle for 3 consecutive ticks.
learningObjective: Master top-to-bottom rule ordering: prioritize arrival, handle openings/junctions, manage blocked corridors, and escape dead ends.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starting brain has primitive actions and no rules.

Build your rule hierarchy: 1) WHEN atGoal -> DO hold, 2) check preferred openings, 3) step forward when clear, 4) turn at walls, and 5) fallback when fully blocked.
hint: Order your rules: arrival first, preferred open side second, clear path third, turn fourth, and fallback last.
hints: Local wall facts (wallAhead, wallLeft, wallRight) are relative to current facing direction.
Place WHEN atGoal -> DO hold at the top of the rules list.
A wall-following strategy systematically prefers an open side wall before stepping forward.
brief: Solve the 11x11 Branching Maze by navigating junctions, dead ends, and winding corridors.
context: The maze contains dead ends and multiple junctions. Unordered rules cause infinite loops.

steps.label: Observe the three relative wall facts (wallAhead, wallLeft, wallRight)
steps.hint: Facts reflect relative facing direction, not fixed map cardinal directions

steps.label: Protect the goal with an atGoal -> hold rule
steps.hint: Put atGoal -> hold at the top of the rule list

steps.label: Handle specific junction choices before general movement fallbacks
steps.hint: Order: arrival -> preferred open side -> clear path -> turn -> fallback

steps.label: Reach the exit and stay on it for 3 ticks
steps.hint: Press Apply & Run to start the simulation
